messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert: tenant-scoped quality regression detected for tenant `aurora-health` on Dedicated Pool `us-east-1-ded-7`. Signal: paragraph_coherence down ~19% vs baseline on canary runs. Rule triggered: tenant_quant_profile_anomaly. Suggested immediate: pause tenant rollout and consider revert. https://console.redwood/incidents/1922223334

Oncall-Eli: ACK. Paging ML-Reliability and Infra-Priyanka. Looping in Customer-SRE-Kate and CS-Liaison-Maya.

Oncall-Eli: Quick notes: started ~14m ago after scheduled tenant-profile promotion job `tenant-qprun-03` applied `quant_profile=qp-int8-balanced` as a tenant override for aurora-health. Other tenants on same pool look fine. Latency unaffected.

ML-Reliability: grabbing eval traces. Nate, do we have their model binding and the exact change id?

SE-Nate: aurora-health pinned to `rdl-m-2.9.1`. Change metadata: change-id=tenant-roll-20260315-qprun03, operator=release-bot. Ticket ref: #11456.

Infra-Priyanka: I can revert tenant override now. Command (hot reload):
```bash
# revert tenant quant_profile
redwood-admin tenant-config revert --tenant aurora-health --key quant_profile --from-change tenant-roll-20260315-qprun03 --author=infra-priyanka --ref rollback-1922223334
```
I'll hold until we confirm.

ML-Reliability: Confirmed repro locally: running the eval harness with the tenant prompt set shows coherence drop concentrated on multi-section discharge summaries (>1000 tokens). Short prompts fine. Suggest revert.

Oncall-Eli: Go ahead with revert. Also add a temporary orchestrator block to prevent reapplication of qp-int8-balanced to this tenant until manual review.

Infra-Priyanka: Applying revert now.

incident-bot: change-applied: rollback-1922223334 by infra-priyanka at 2026-03-15T14:12:46Z. Hot-reload succeeded, no restart required.

ML-Reliability: Spinning up fast eval (sample=700, mix=0.7 historical/0.3 live) comparing qp-int8-balanced -> qp-fp16-safe on rdl-m-2.9.1. ETA ~6m. Extra logging enabled for attention projections.

SE-Nate: I pinned the router for aurora-health to ensure stable variant:
```bash
redwood-router override set --tenant aurora-health --model rdl-m-2.9.1@stable --force-pin --note "post-rollback pin"
```
This bypasses canary routing for that tenant until we validate.

CS-Liaison-Maya: Drafting customer-facing note: "We detected a configuration change affecting long-form summary quality and have rolled it back. You should see behavior return to prior levels within minutes. We'll follow up with a short report and next steps." Kate, do you want to review before I send?

Customer-SRE-Kate: Please send. I've got a bridge open with their on-call and they're waiting for the mitigation. Ask them to run their verification tests and report any residual issues.

ML-Reliability: Preliminary eval: paragraph_coherence recovered to ~97% of baseline after rollback and pin. The failure mode appears reproducible on prompts that include long tables and multi-section concatenations. Saving diffs to the incident store.

Oncall-Eli: Handoff: ML-Reliability owns the RCA and quant-pipeline fixes; Customer-SRE-Kate will manage customer comms and validation; Infra-Priyanka will codify blocks in the rollout service. I'll remain on-call for the next 45m.

ML-Reliability: Initial hypothesis: the `qp-int8-balanced` variant reduces precision in key/value projection kernels which amplifies drift for long-context positional interactions. Reproducer commands I used:
```bash
python tools/eval_harness.py --tenant aurora-health --model rdl-m-2.9.1 --quant qp-int8-balanced --sample 700 --out /tmp/aurora_qp_int8.json
python tools/eval_harness.py --tenant aurora-health --model rdl-m-2.9.1 --quant qp-fp16-safe --sample 700 --out /tmp/aurora_qp_fp16.json
python tools/compare_evals.py /tmp/aurora_qp_int8.json /tmp/aurora_qp_fp16.json --metrics paragraph_coherence,rouge-l
```

ML-Reliability: Action items I'm taking: 1) run full 5k sample overnight against live traffic and attach diffs 2) bisect quantization steps to identify offending kernel 3) add long-context unit tests in quant pipeline and 4) open PR to disable tenant-level auto-promote for aggressive int8 profiles until tests + sign-off done.

Infra-Priyanka: I've added a block to the rollout service: `blocklist.add(tenant='aurora-health', profile='qp-int8-balanced', until='manual_clear')` and annotated ops ticket #11456. Also added an alert if any automated job attempts to reapply it.

SE-Nate: Follow-ups: add a contract-level opt-out toggle for aggressive quant profiles and require a sample-based quality gate (developer-defined threshold) prior to tenant promotions. Raising a JIRA.

CS-Liaison-Maya: Sent the message to the customer; they replied: "Thanks for the quick response. We'll run verification on our end and update if anything odd remains."

Oncall-Eli: Closing the live page: rollback applied, smoke evals pass, customer notified. Incident marked mitigated. Keep thread open for RCA upload and link to PRs.

incident-bot: Incident 1922223334 status -> mitigated (recovered). Please attach RCA doc, eval diffs, and PR links to incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/1922223334

ML-Reliability: I'll post RCA, the diffs, and proposed guardrail changes by EOD and link the PR to disable auto-promote. Will include suggested UI change for tenant opt-out. :memo:
